title: California Public Contract Code section 5101 - No relief from a bid without consent; action to recover forfeited amount
claims: Section 5101(a) provides that a bidder shall not be relieved of the bid unless by consent of the awarding authority nor shall any change be made in the bid because of mistake, but the bidder may bring an action against the public entity in a court of competent jurisdiction in the county in which the bids were opened for the recovery of the amount forfeited, without interest or costs.

Section 5101(a) provides that if the plaintiff fails to recover judgment, the plaintiff shall pay all costs incurred by the public entity in the suit, including a reasonable attorney's fee to be fixed by the court.

Section 5101(b) provides that if an awarding authority for the state consents to relieve a bidder of a bid because of mistake, the authority shall prepare a written report documenting the facts establishing the existence of each element required by Section 5103, available for inspection as a public record.
